notes.title: Oil Town Demo now available for a limited time!
notes.notes: [p][b]Ahoy![/b] The [b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3932280/Oil_Town_Demo/"]Oil Town[/url][/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3932280/Oil_Town_Demo/"] Demo[/url][/b] is now live! Featuring an early look at the first 12 days in the game. [i]Oil Town[/i] is a spinoff of [i]Final Profit[/i], with a story that ties into the grand plot of the series.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Demos are free![/b] So check it out! Steam demos can now receive reviews separate from the main game, so please consider leaving one if you have a good time![/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow the development[/b] of [i]Oil Town[/i], and join the discussion on [url="https://discord.com/invite/VX7M58RfJn"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="9j3BC515PFI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b][i]Oil Town[/i][/b] is also taking part in the [b]ANZ Indie Showcase[/b], [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vy-Z6Lg4pW4"]check out the showcase here[/url]. There's a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ANZIndieFest2025"]Steam sale page[/url] with plenty of local goodies to dive into as well.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623808/26b5faa1b72807847188fac09fec9d9220728bd5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks for playing![/h2][p]I hope you have fun![/p]
